newsitem.title: FRANCE: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde Oct 3.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde Oct 3.

text.p: These are leading stories in afternoon daily Le Monde.
-- Pharmaceutical sector officials worried about fact that some products forbidden in France are available through mail-order on the Internet.
-- Snecma allegedly considers pulling out of larger engine research projects to concentrate on more profitable projects.
-- EU authorities to take further look at French state help to textile sector which they fear may distort competitiveness.
-- Bidders for privatisation of shipping company Compagnie Generale Maritime face deadline today, bidder expected to carry on links with French overseas territories.
-- Bollore Technologies to make an offer for transport group Saga.
-- French government disagrees with EU commission's intention of further deregulate European railways.

-- Some pharmaceutical laboratories such as Smithkline Beecham to cut prices of brandname products to resist promotion of cheaper, generic drugs, but keep up price of new products to finance research.
